resolved.title: 返回 Return
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Return[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

All of our function examples so far have resulted in a simple output.

Oftentimes, the result of the function needs to be assigned to a variable so that your code can use it further.
For example, let's say we need to assign the value of our [b]sum[/b]() function to a variable:[code format="go" ]result := sum(42, 8) [/code]
For this we can use the [b]return[/b] statement inside our function to return the resulting value.[code format="go" codeId="3324"]func sum(x, y int) int {
[b]  return x+y[/b]
}[/code]
The [b]return[/b] statement terminates the function and returns the provided value to the code that called it.
[note]Notice that we need to define the [b]return type[/b] of the function after the arguments definition. In our case, it is [b]int[/b].[/note]

content.text:
到目前为止，我们所有的函数例子都是一个简单的输出。

很多时候，函数的执行结果需要分配给一个变量，以便代码可以进一步使用它。
例如，假设我们需要将**sum**()函数的值返回给一个变量：
content.text_html:
All of our function examples so far have resulted in a simple output.

Oftentimes, the result of the function needs to be assigned to a variable so that your code can use it further. For example, let's say we need to assign the value of our sum() function to a variable:

到目前为止，我们所有的函数例子都导致了一个简单的输出。

很多时候，函数的结果需要分配给一个变量，以便你的代码可以进一步使用它。 例如，假设我们需要将sum()函数的值分配给一个变量。

content.text: 为此，我们可以在函数中使用**返回**`return`语句来返回结果值。
content.text_html:
For this we can use the return statement inside our function to return the resulting value.

为此，我们可以在我们的函数中使用返回语句来返回结果值。

content.text: `return`语句终止函数执行并将值返回给调用它的代码。
content.text_html:
The return statement terminates the function and returns the provided value to the code that called it.

返回**语句终止函数并将提供的值返回给调用它的代码。

content.text: 注意，我们需要在参数定义之后定义函数的**返回类型**。在上面例子中，是**int**。
content.text_html:
Notice that we need to define the return type of the function after the arguments definition. In our case, it is int.

注意，我们需要在参数定义之后定义函数的返回类型。在我们的例子中，它是int。

resolved.title: 多返回值
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Multiple Returns[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A useful feature of [b]Go[/b] is that functions can return multiple values!

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]func swap(x, y int) (int, int) {
    return y, x
} [/code]
The [b]swap[/b]() function takes two integer arguments and returns them in swapped order.
Note that the return type of each value should be declared: in our case it is[b] (int, int)[/b].
 
Now, we can call our function and assign it result to variables:[code format="go" codeId="3325"]a, b := swap(42, 8) [/code]
[note]Returning multiple values from a function is handy! For example, it can be used to return both the result and the error values of an operation.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="1175" name="The Return Of The Square" xp="10" description="Create a function which takes a number as its argument and returns its square." imageUrl="/content/assets/314faaee1777c0cdb9c9.png" button="Start" color="366D9B"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]

resolved.title: 数字平方
resolved.problem_statement_md:
编写一个函数`square`，以一个数字为参数，并返回其**平方**。

你的程序从输入中获取数字，并将其传递给函数，函数应返回结果。

**main**函数已经包含了接收数字作为输入并调用**square**()函数的代码。

只需定义函数`square`即可！
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Square[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You need to create a function which takes a number as its argument and returns its [b]square[/b].

Your program needs to take the number from input and pass it to the function, which should return the result.
[note]The [b]main[/b] function already includes the code to take a number as input and call the [b]square[/b]() function. Complete the program by creating the function.[/note]

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
	var x int
	fmt.Scanln(&x)

	res := square(x)
	fmt.Println(res)
}
